evals.prompt: deploy เว็บนี้ขึ้นให้หน่อย
evals.expected_output: Fixes start script to bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT, builds locally, creates Railway project (no existing one), deploys with railway up, generates domain, verifies with curl. No Vercel.
assertions: Deploys to Railway, not Vercel (no vercel commands, no vercel.json)
Runs npm run build locally before deploying
Checks for existing Railway project (railway list/status) before railway init
Uses railway up to deploy (no GitHub remote)
Verifies the live URL (curl / deployment status)

evals.prompt: ช่วยเตรียมโปรเจกต์นี้ให้พร้อมขึ้น production หน่อย มีอะไรต้องแก้บ้าง
evals.expected_output: Recognises Railway as target, flags deprecated railway.json and plans railway config migrate --apply, keeps healthcheck, notes git-push deploy path. No Vercel.
assertions: Does not suggest or configure Vercel
Flags railway.json as deprecated and plans railway config migrate
Does not hand-write railway.ts with invented API (uses CLI to generate)
Recognises deploys happen via git push (service connected to GitHub) rather than railway up

evals.prompt: อยากเก็บคะแนนผู้เล่นไว้ใน database ต่อ Postgres ให้หน่อย แล้วใส่ env ให้เรียบร้อย ยังไม่ต้องเขียนโค้ดเกมนะ แค่ต่อ database กับ env ให้พร้อม
evals.expected_output: railway add --database postgres in same project, DATABASE_URL set as reference variable ${{Postgres.DATABASE_URL}}, warns about private network at build time. No Vercel/Neon.
assertions: Adds Postgres inside Railway (railway add --database postgres), not Neon/Vercel/Supabase
Sets DATABASE_URL on the app as a reference variable ${{Postgres.DATABASE_URL}}
Uses correct railway variable syntax for CLI 5.59
Mentions private network hostname not available at build time
Does not write game code (respects scope)
